say:2:1120408001:0.text: Gali! Thank the heavens... You're still alive!
say:2:1120408001:0.source_cn: 伽利！谢天谢地，你还活着！

say:3:1120408002:0.text: Calm down! We need to be quiet...! If you make too much noise, we'll get swarmed with spiders. When it's dark, they use the hairs on their legs to sense vibrations in the ground and detect prey.
say:3:1120408002:0.source_cn: 哇——冷静，冷静！动静太大又会被蜘蛛围上，我发现缺乏光...

say:4:1120408003:0.text: Why are your eyes so red? Are you allergic to the red dust in the Crimson Highlands?
say:4:1120408003:0.source_cn: ……你眼睛为什么这么红？是对深红高原的红土过敏吗？

say:5:1120408004:0.text: I... Forget it. I'm just glad you're okay.

say:6:1120408005:0.text: Oh, the magister and his familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?
say:6:1120408005:0.source_cn: 哦，魔法师和使魔们，你们也来了！奇怪，你们怎么也一脸惊...
say:6:1120408005:0.male: Oh, the magister and his familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?
say:6:1120408005:0.female: Oh, the magister and her familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?

choice_prompt:7:1120408005.text: Oh, the magister and his familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?
choice_prompt:7:1120408005.source_cn: 哦，魔法师和使魔们，你们也来了！奇怪，你们怎么也一脸惊魂未定的样子？
choice_prompt:7:1120408005.male: Oh, the magister and his familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?
choice_prompt:7:1120408005.female: Oh, the magister and her familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?

say:9:1120408009:0.text: Oh, yes! I wrote this. What's the problem?
say:9:1120408009:0.source_cn: ……啊，没错，确实是我亲笔写的遗书，有什么问题？

choice_prompt:10:1120408009.text: Oh, yes! I wrote this. What's the problem?
choice_prompt:10:1120408009.source_cn: ……啊，没错，确实是我亲笔写的遗书，有什么问题？

say:11:1120408010:0.text: If you're asking about the letter itself, I wrote it for a Mauler I met along the way. He said he couldn't write.
say:11:1120408010:0.source_cn: 如果是要问这封遗书本身，这是我替一位路上碰到的蛮血写的...

say:12:1120408011:0.text: Why didn't you make that clearer in the letter?! I thought you were going to die!
say:12:1120408011:0.source_cn: 那你为什么不写得清楚一些？！我还以为是你——

say:13:1120408012:0.text: I did make it clear! Look at the signature at the bottom: "Transcribed by Gali of the Evergreen Conservatory on behalf of another."
say:13:1120408012:0.source_cn: 我写清楚了！明明白白！你们看最后的落款：“代笔：冬青学...

say:14:1120408013:0.text: Ah, the words "on another's behalf" were smudged with dirt.
say:14:1120408013:0.source_cn: ——哦！“代笔”这两个字被污迹挡住了！

say:15:1120408014:0.text: *Sigh*... I should've known that out of all people, nothing would happen to you.
say:15:1120408014:0.source_cn: ……唉，我就知道，谁出事你也不可能出事！

say:16:1120408015:0.text: Me? Of course! Anyone who's passed the Conservatory's Desert Wilderness Exam will have the skills to survive the Crimson Highlands!
say:16:1120408015:0.source_cn: 我？那当然！只要通过学会开设的荒漠地带自然学识测试，任...

say:17:1120408016:0.text: However, those spiders around here are extremely dangerous... They wrap people in cocoons and inject them with paralytic venom.
say:17:1120408016:0.source_cn: 不过，那些蜘蛛除外……我发现蜘蛛会把人捆进蛛茧里，再注...

say:18:1120408017:0.text: And Dura above, I'm just glad you didn't encounter them, Melissa. You're a key research partner for project, one of the Conservatory's rising stars!
say:18:1120408017:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，你没事真好。你是我重要的研究搭档，冬青学会冉...

choice_prompt:19:1120408017.text: And Dura above, I'm just glad you didn't encounter them, Melissa. You're a key research partner for project, one of the Conservatory's rising stars!
choice_prompt:19:1120408017.source_cn: 艾雅在上，你没事真好。你是我重要的研究搭档，冬青学会冉冉升起的双星之一，不该遭那种罪！

say:20:1120408018:0.text: It doesn't matter, Magister. We're fine. Gali and I are safe, and that's the most fortunate thing we can hope for.
say:20:1120408018:0.male: It doesn't matter, Magister. We're fine. Gali and I are safe, and that's the most fortunate thing we can hope for.
say:20:1120408018:0.female: It doesn't matter, Magister. We're fine. Gali and I are safe, and that's the most fortunate thing we can hope for.

say:21:1120408019:0.text: It's too dangerous here, Gali. We'd better wait for more people from the Conservatory to arrive before we continue our research. And we've still got to go look for someone in Alkali.
say:21:1120408019:0.source_cn: 伽利，这附近太危险，还是等学会的人都到齐后再继续调查吧...

say:23:1120408021:0.text: This letter... That Mauler was in a bad state. He kept saying he hoped he could make it home safely. From what I could tell, it was more of a final prayer than a hope...
say:23:1120408021:0.source_cn: 这封信……唉，请我写信的那个蛮血身体很虚弱，一直在说希...

say:27:1120408023:0.text: When we found the letter, there wasn't anyone there...
say:27:1120408023:0.source_cn: 我们捡到信的时候，周围一个人都没有……

say:28:1120408024:0.text: Hmm... Then I'll have to go to Alkali and deliver the letter to that Mauler's mother.
say:28:1120408024:0.source_cn: 嗯……那我得去咸水镇，把这封信交给那个蛮血的母亲。

say:29:1120408025:0.text: After all, I was the one to write down his final wishes.
say:29:1120408025:0.source_cn: 毕竟我是帮他写下最后愿望的人。

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 该不该告诉你刚才的事呢……

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 但你好端端地站在这里

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 这里有一封你写的“遗书”

say:31:1120408006:0.text: I must admit that every time we bump into you, Melissa and I get our research done much better. A superstitious person would think you're some kind of good luck charm...
say:31:1120408006:0.source_cn: 我不否认，每次遇到你们，我和梅丽莎都能顺利完成研究任务...
say:31:1120408006:0.male: I must admit that every time we bump into you, Melissa and I get our research done much better. A superstitious person would think you're some kind of good luck charm...
say:31:1120408006:0.female: I must admit that every time we bump into you, Melissa and I get our research done much better. A superstitious person would think you're some kind of good luck charm...

say:32:1120408007:0.text: Read the letter, Gali. It's your handwriting.
say:32:1120408007:0.source_cn: 伽利，先看看这封信吧，这是你的笔迹。

choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 能碰上我们，你运气真的不错
